name: xaihi-workspace
description: Xaihi: a workspace extension framework and domain node ecosystem for DeepSeek Harness.

scripts.test: pnpm check:pins && pnpm check:skills && pnpm check:panels && pnpm check:installable && pnpm -r run build && pnpm -r run typecheck && pnpm -r --no-bail run test:unit
scripts.plugin:add: DSH_HOME=$PWD/../.scratch/dsh-xaihi-home pnpm exec dsh plugin --profile xaihi add
scripts.plugin:install: DSH_HOME=$PWD/../.scratch/dsh-xaihi-home pnpm exec dsh plugin --profile xaihi install
scripts.plugin:remove: DSH_HOME=$PWD/../.scratch/dsh-xaihi-home pnpm exec dsh plugin --profile xaihi remove
